projects.title: CollaborateX
projects.description: A video Conferencing app that allows users to create and join video calls, share screens, and collaborate in real-time.
projects.longDescription:
CollaborateX is a cutting-edge video conferencing solution designed to bridge the gap between remote teams. Built with performance and scalability in mind, it leverages WebRTC for low-latency peer-to-peer communication. 

 Users can create instant meeting rooms, share their screens for presentations, and communicate via real-time chat. The application features a modern, intuitive interface that makes joining calls seamless without the need for complex software installations.

projects.title: TicTacToe
projects.description: A simple Tic Tac Toe game built with React and Tailwind CSS.
projects.longDescription:
A classic Tic Tac Toe game reimagined with a modern aesthetic. This project showcases the power of React's state management and component-based architecture. 

 It features a clean, responsive design, a game history tracking system that allows players to jump back to previous moves, and a winning logic algorithm that highlights the victory path. Perfect for a quick break and a demonstration of clean code practices.

projects.title: Tradewave
projects.description: TradeWave is a B2B e-commerce platform featuring a mobile app for business customers and a web admin panel for managing vendors, products, orders, and platform operations.
projects.longDescription:
TradeWave revolutionizes B2B commerce by providing a comprehensive ecosystem for vendors and business customers. 

 The platform consists of two main components: a powerful Mobile App built with React Native for customers to browse catalogs, place bulk orders, and track shipments; and a sophisticated Web Admin Panel for vendors to manage inventory, analyze sales data, and process orders efficiently. It handles complex business logic like bulk pricing, minimum order quantities, and vendor-specific catalogs.
